title: Q-ULTRA-owner_interventions-1: Owner interventions out of bounds: absorb: turn each owner intervention of the last 7 days into a variable, bound, detector or rule here, so the same message is never needed twice
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** essential variable `owner_interventions` out of bounds (reading 23; limits 0 to 0)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** open

ULTRASTABILITY-1 second-order step: absorb: turn each owner intervention of the last 7 days into a variable, bound, detector or rule here, so the same message is never needed twice. Every time Rowan has to notice a problem and redirect the system in chat, he is acting as the second loop. Ultrastable means the system does that itself. Counted from provenance: distinct thread sessions that changed the repository.

**Prediction:** owner.interventions_7d >= 0 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** changing the bounds of `owner_interventions` or any other essential variable; a step is judged by the reading, never by relaxing the limit.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `owner_interventions` inside its bounds.
